description: Send a preview of a saved workspace template to one email address, so the user can see it in a real inbox. It arrives from noreply@send16.com with a small 'Template test preview' banner and uses sample merge values (first name 'Test'). Only send to the user's own address unless they ask otherwise.

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

templateId.description: Template id from save_template or list_workspace_templates

name: send_template_test
